race.comment: MANNERHEIM (2) would only need to find his best form to be winning this. To be fair he hasn't done that when down in Victoria. But the last effort, coming when leading, showed a glimpse of that. Maybe that might spark him up. UP AND UNDER (4) has also started to show more his last couple. He was backing up last week and does it again here. Can get a nice cart into the race. TASSADAR (6) has been getting closer for a while. The winkers come off now. Will he be taking up that prominent position again? He will be at peak fitness now. BLANCHE BASS (8) finally got the maiden win out of the way. It did come over a much longer trip. SPIRIT ANGEL (12) has trialled since her latest effort. She may place again.
